session_summary: NeoClaw-Rails: from spec to running infrastructure in one session. Built the Hub, Manager, Relay, WireGuard network, and admin UI. Eight commits. Claude Code boots and authenticates inside agent containers. One relay bug left.

hub.what: Rails app. Matrix appservice. Routing table.
key_files: app/services/hub/router.rb — the heart, routes Matrix messages to agents

manager.what: Rails app. Container lifecycle. Auth provisioning. Admin UI.
manager.db: SQLite — containers, agent_configs, room_configs, agent_room_configs, service_types, audit_logs
key_files: app/services/spawner.rb — the spawn flow, IP allocation, spawn.json generation
app/services/lifecycle.rb — freeze, sunset, force kill, teardown
app/services/provisioner.rb — Forgejo users, SSH keys, API tokens
app/services/wireguard.rb — calls wg-admin helper for peer management
app/services/podman.rb — container creation via podman socket
config/initializers/surface.rb — declares everything the Manager touches
manager.admin_ui: Tailwind, dark stone/amber palette. Dashboard, agent configs with service checkboxes, room configs, container monitoring with stream viewer, audit log.

relay.what: Lives inside every agent container. WireGuard + Claude Code glue.
relay.auth: Copies ~/.claude/.credentials.json from mounted secret. OAuth token, not API key.
relay.containerfile: relay/Containerfile — ruby:3.3-slim + node/npm + wireguard-tools + Claude Code

wg_admin.what: Tiny HTTP helper on the host. Accepts add-peer/remove-peer from Manager.

network.routing: Source-based policy routing. Each service IP gets a routing table (ip rule add from <ip> lookup <table>). Responses go through the correct WG interface.
network.ufw_rules: Allow UDP 51820:51829 on podman bridge (WG handshakes). Allow all from 10.0.0.0/16 on all wg-* interfaces (peering IS auth).
network.init_script: infra/init.sh — builds entire WG network from infra/services.conf. Idempotent. Run with sudo.
network.keys: infra/wireguard/keys/ — all WG keypairs. Private keys are 0600.

what_works: Hub Rails app boots, receives Matrix events, routes to identities, resolves via Manager
Manager Rails app boots, admin UI renders with Tailwind, all CRUD works
Manager seeds: 9 identities, 6 service types, 2 room configs, room overrides for margaux+parallax in #art
WireGuard: 9 interfaces live, source-based policy routing proven with 4 test pods
Authorization: unauthorized paths blocked, authorized paths work, internet works
Agent container image builds successfully (ruby:3.3-slim + Claude Code + WG tools)
Claude Code authenticates and runs inside containers (proven manually with OAuth credentials)
Claude Code clones repos, reads identity files, responds to prompts inside containers

relay_process_management.symptom: Open3.popen3 with uid: 1000 appears to hang during long multi-turn boot invocations. The relay logs 'Invoking: fresh' and never logs the response.
relay_process_management.proven_working: The EXACT same invocation works when run manually inside the container via podman exec. Claude Code authenticates, clones, reads files, responds.
theories: Stdout buffering — popen3 block might not flush until process exits, and Claude Code's boot prompt takes many turns (clone + read identity + read baton + orient)
Process group issue — su or uid switching might not properly attach stdout
OOM — container has 2GB memory limit, Claude Code + Node + Ruby might exceed it
what_to_try_next: Add logging inside the popen3 block to confirm whether stdout lines are arriving
Try PTY.spawn instead of Open3.popen3 — may handle uid switching better
Try running relay as agent user directly (not root→uid switch) and use a separate init process for WG
Check container memory: podman stats test-silas during boot
Try the old NeoClaw approach: entrypoint.sh runs as root for WG, then gosu to agent for everything else

what_doesnt_work_yet.matrix_end_to_end: Hub is connected to Synapse but never tested with a real message. The routing code is untested against live Matrix events.
what_doesnt_work_yet.manager_spawn_flow: The Manager's Spawner.resolve is written but never called via the API. The Hub→Manager→Container chain is untested.

things_that_bit_us: WireGuard multi-interface routing: kernel can only have one route per destination. Solved with source-based policy routing (ip rule add from <service-ip> lookup <table>).
Bridge back door: podman containers have default route through bridge, can reach host-local WG IPs. Fixed with iptables INPUT rule.
UFW blocks WG handshake UDP from pods. Fixed with ufw allow on podman bridge.
UFW blocks service TCP through WG interfaces. Fixed with ufw allow from 10.0.0.0/16 on all wg-* interfaces.
Claude Code refuses --dangerously-skip-permissions as root. Agent container needs a non-root user.
Claude Code uses OAuth credentials in ~/.claude/.credentials.json, not ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var.
Old NeoClaw WG interfaces were holding the same ports we needed. Had to tear them down first.
Propshaft asset resolution: Tailwind builds need app/assets/builds/ registered as an asset path.
Ruby rescue inside while needs begin/end block (syntax difference from method-level rescue).
Rails allow_browser on API controllers will 406 infrastructure requests.

useful_files: container/entrypoint.sh — Phase 1 (root: WG, secrets, SSH), Phase 2 (gosu node: relay). THE reference for container boot.
container/Dockerfile — base image, gosu for user switching
hub/ — TypeScript Hub (being replaced by Rails Hub)
manager/ — Python Manager (being replaced by Rails Manager)
old_neoclaw_reference.key_pattern: Credentials at /run/secrets/claude-credentials → copied to ~/.claude/.credentials.json. Settings pre-allowed via settings.json. gosu for root→user transition.
